items.title: CosmicSting attack & defense overview
items.summary: CosmicSting is described as the worst bug to hit Magento and Adobe Commerce stores in two years, with Sansec observing stores getting hacked at a rate of 5 to 30 per hour. Merchants need to take immediate action.

items.title: SessionReaper, unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: SessionReaper is a critical bug in Magento & Adobe Commerce that may hand full control of a store to unauthenticated attackers. Automated attacks have reportedly hit over 50% of all stores.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect authorization vulnerability leading to elevated access
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. Indications suggest threat actors are attempting to exploit it in the wild.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Unauthenticated arbitrary code execution via webhooks
items.summary: Rated with a CVSS score of 10.0, this unauthenticated, zero-interaction flaw in the webhooks component can lead to arbitrary code execution, allowing an attacker with no account or login to run code on the store.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: This unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution. Amasty fixed it in version 4.0.0.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento full-page cache extension, which can lead to remote code execution via a crafted cookie. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) on May 25, 2026.

items.title: Stored cross-site scripting vulnerability
items.summary: This high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution and requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored cross-site scripting vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Incorrect-authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability affects Adobe Commerce B2B and could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect-authorization vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Plant malicious files on the server
items.summary: This vulnerability, part of APSB26-73, allows an attacker to plant malicious files on the server.

items.title: Privilege escalation / feature bypass
items.summary: This vulnerability, part of APSB26-73, allows for privilege escalation or security feature bypass.

items.title: Privilege escalation / feature bypass
items.summary: This vulnerability, part of APSB26-73, allows for privilege escalation or security feature bypass.
